    Fullness for arbitrary ordinary-arrow representatives #

    Any representatives of the ordinary arrows span the first layer of the radical filtration. Their composites then span every successive layer modulo the next one, and nilpotence terminates the approximation. Over an algebraically closed field, an endomorphism of an indecomposable projective is a scalar identity modulo the radical, so every representative-dependent free path realization is full.
